title: Hearth
text: Someone has written HEARTH on the wall by the Core in charcoal, under the planet's catalogue number. By evening half the colony is saying it. Nobody voted. Nobody asked us.

choices.label: Use it in the logs
choices.reply: The logs say Hearth now. The interface still says HOME. Some things take longer.

choices.label: Keep the catalogue name
choices.reply: The logs keep the number. The colonists keep the name.
